import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 98765432;
    static int N, T;
    static char[][] B = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] B1 = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] B2 = new char[12][12];
    static int[][] D1 = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] D2 = new int[12][12];
    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static int[] dc = {0, -1, 1, 0};
    
    static class Pos {
        int row, col;
        Pos(int _row, int _col) {
            this.row = _row;
            this.col = _col;
        }
    }
    
    public static void bfs1(Pos src) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(D1[i], -1);
        }
        D1[src.row][src.col] = 0;
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nr = cur.row + dr[k];
                int nc = cur.col + dc[k];
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= N + 2 || nc < 0 || nc >= N + 2) continue;
                if (B[nr][nc] != '.') continue;
                if (D1[nr][nc] < 0) {
                    D1[nr][nc] = D1[cur.row][cur.col] + 1;
                    q.offer(new Pos(nr, nc));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    public static void bfs2(Pos src) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(D2[i], -1);
        }
        D2[src.row][src.col] = 0;
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            if (D1[cur.row][cur.col] >= 0 && D2[cur.row][cur.col] >= D1[cur.row][cur.col]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nr = cur.row + dr[k];
                int nc = cur.col + dc[k];
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= N + 2 || nc < 0 || nc >= N + 2) continue;
                if (B[nr][nc] != '.') continue;
                if (D2[nr][nc] < 0) {
                    if (D1[nr][nc] >= 0 && D1[nr][nc] < D2[cur.row][cur.col] + 1) continue;
                    D2[nr][nc] = D2[cur.row][cur.col] + 1;
                    q.offer(new Pos(nr, nc));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static class MaxFlow {
        int N;
        List<List<Integer>> cap;
        List<List<Integer>> flow;
        int[] bfs_par;
        int[] bfs_D;
        
        MaxFlow(int _N) {
            this.N = _N;
            cap = new ArrayList<>();
            flow = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                List<Integer> rowCap = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(N, 0));
                cap.add(rowCap);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                List<Integer> rowFlow = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(N, 0));
                flow.add(rowFlow);
            }
            bfs_par = new int[N];
            Arrays.fill(bfs_par, -1);
            bfs_D = new int[N];
        }
        
        void add_edge(int u, int v, int _cap) {
            cap.get(u).set(v, cap.get(u).get(v) + _cap);
        }
        
        int[] augmenting_path_bfs(int src, int dst, List<Integer> path, int mincap) {
            Arrays.fill(bfs_par, -1);
            Arrays.fill(bfs_D, -1);
            bfs_D[src] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(src);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int cur = q.poll();
                if (cur == dst) {
                    int cfp = INF;
                    path.clear();
                    int k = bfs_D[dst];
                    for (int curv = dst; curv >= 0; curv = bfs_par[curv]) {
                        path.add(curv);
                        if (bfs_par[curv] >= 0) {
                            int prev = bfs_par[curv];
                            cfp = Math.min(cfp, cap.get(prev).get(curv) - flow.get(prev).get(curv));
                        }
                    }
                    Collections.reverse(path);
                    return new int[]{cfp};
                }
                for (int v = 0; v < N; v++) {
                    if (bfs_D[v] < 0 && cap.get(cur).get(v) - flow.get(cur).get(v) > mincap) {
                        bfs_D[v] = bfs_D[cur] + 1;
                        bfs_par[v] = cur;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return new int[]{0};
        }
        
        int dinic(int s, int t) {
            int res = 0;
            while (true) {
                List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
                int[] cfpArr = augmenting_path_bfs(s, t, path,0);
                int cfp = cfpArr[0];
                if (path.isEmpty()) {
                    break;
                }
                // Augment path
                for (int i = 0; i < path.size() -1; i++) {
                    int u = path.get(i);
                    int v = path.get(i+1);
                    flow.get(u).set(v, flow.get(u).get(v) + cfp);
                    flow.get(v).set(u, -flow.get(u).get(v));
                }
                res += cfp;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        
        for (int i=0; i<12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(B1[i], '#');
            Arrays.fill(B2[i], '#');
            Arrays.fill(B[i], '#');
        }
        
        for (int r=1; r<=N; r++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            B1[r]= ('#' + line + '#').toCharArray();
        }
        for (int r=1; r<=N; r++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            B2[r]= ('#' + line + '#').toCharArray();
        }
        
        List<Pos> scientists = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Pos> capsules = new ArrayList<>();
        Pos z = new Pos(0,0);
        
        for (int r=1; r<=N; r++) {
            for (int c=1; c<=N; c++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(B1[r][c])) {
                    if (B1[r][c] > '0') {
                        scientists.add(new Pos(r, c));
                    }
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                } else if (B1[r][c]=='Z') {
                    z = new Pos(r, c);
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(B2[r][c]) && B2[r][c]>'0') {
                    capsules.add(new Pos(r, c));
                }
            }
        }
        
        bfs1(z);
        int SRC = 0;
        int SINK = scientists.size()+capsules.size()+1;
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow(SINK+1);
        
        for (int i=0; i<scientists.size(); i++) {
            Pos s = scientists.get(i);
            int capCount = B1[s.row][s.col]-'0';
            mf.add_edge(SRC, i+1, capCount);
        }
        for (int j=0; j<capsules.size(); j++) {
            Pos c = capsules.get(j);
            int capCount = B2[c.row][c.col]-'0';
            mf.add_edge(scientists.size()+j+1, SINK, capCount);
        }
        for (int i=0; i<scientists.size(); i++) {
            Pos s=scientists.get(i);
            bfs2(s);
            for (int j=0; j<capsules.size(); j++) {
                Pos c=capsules.get(j);
                if (D2[c.row][c.col]>=0 && D2[c.row][c.col]<=T) {
                    mf.add_edge(i+1, scientists.size() + j + 1, INF);
                }
            }
        }
        int res=mf.dinic(SRC, SINK);
        System.out.println(res);
    }
}
